Data Engineer
Tailspin Analytics - Chicago, IL (hybrid)

We help airlines understand their operations. You'll join a small data platform team.

Responsibilities
• Build and maintain batch and streaming pipelines
• Model data in the warehouse for analysts
• Monitor data quality and fix issues at the source

Requirements
• Solid SQL and Python
• Experience with Apache Airflow and dbt
• Cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake or BigQuery

Bonus points
• Spark or Flink
• Dashboards in Looker

Entry level candidates with internship experience are welcome.
